'''Mianda''' was  a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the early [[Time/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point during his life he joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] as a pilot. He proved to be very skilled and versatile pilot, and he eventually attained the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]] and became the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] squadron assigned to defend the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]] during construction called [[Scythe Squadron/Legends|Scythe Squadron]]. The Major hand picked pilots to serve with him. He piloted ''[[Scythe 1]]'' during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and pursued Rebel starfighters in the Death Star's corridors.

==Biography==
The human male Mianda was born sometime prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and at some point chose to join the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial navy]] as a pilot. He proved to be a skillful pilot and would eventually rise through the ranks attaining the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]]. At some point he became the commanding officer of an [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Starfighter]] squadron known as [[Scythe Squadron/Legends|Scythe Squadron]] and would personally choose pilot's who were worthy and talented enough to fly alongside him. One of these pilot's was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] named [[Hebsly/Legends|Hebsly]] who was assigned to the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]] for a time before joining Scythe Squadron. Mianda's personal TIE Starfighter was designated [[Scythe 1]].<ref name="Customizable Card Game" />

By the year [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Mianda along with the rest of Scythe Squadron were assigned to protect the new Imperial battle station, the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] which being constructed above the [[Endor/Legends|sanctuary moon]] of the gas giant [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="Customizable Card Game" /> During this time, he along with a number of other officers and Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were ordered to make their way to one of the battle station's hangars by the commander, [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]] to greet the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]]'s Sith apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. He had arrived to discuss the battle station's slow construction with Jerjerrod, eventually revealing to him that the Emperor was coming to oversee the construction personally, much to Jerjerrod's chagrin. He finally announced that they would accelerate construction and Vader left the hangar leaving a very anxious Jerjerrod.<ref name="ROTJ" />
[[File:Scythe1-CCGDS2.jpg|left|thumb|250px|''Scythe 1'', Mianda's TIE starfighter.]]
A few days after their encounter, the Death Star II was [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attacked]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who sought to eradicate the superweapon and cripple the Imperial hierarchy. One squad of pilot's, led by [[General/Legends|general]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was given the task of infiltrating the battle station's superstructure and destroying the main reactor. Calrissian, along with [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and a few other pilot's flew directly into one of the tunnels leading to the reactor core, though they were pursued by several TIE Starfighters. Among them were Mianda and Hebsly piloting their respective TIE fighters. The Imperial pilots gave chase, and managed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] one of the pilots - [[Keir Santage/Legends|Keir Santage]]. Calrissian, wanting to lose the heat told [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]] and some of the other pilots to break off from the main attack group so they could lure away the TIE pilots. Farrell complied and he along with a few other rebels flew into a separate tunnel and the Imperial pilots, including Mianda and Hebsly followed suit.<ref name="ROTJ" />

The battle would turn out to be a victory for the Rebellion however, as Calrissian and Antilles managed to successfully reach the main reactor and destroyed it using [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. They then quickly made haste and escaped the exploding superweapon flying out into open space before the Death Star completely blew up into a massive conflagration, taking Jerjerrod and the Emperor with it.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Mianda was a seasoned Imperial TIE pilot and an accomplished flight leader and commanding officer. He and his squadmates had developed a notable reputation as adept and pedantic pilots, and as such were given the great responsibility of protecting the Death Star from attackers.<ref name="Customizable Card Game" />

==Equipment==
During his service, Mianda wore a black [[Imperial Navy crewman]]'s [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]]. His TIE Fighter, designated Scythe 1 was modified and fitted with upgraded [[P-w702 maneuvering jet|P-w702 manuevering jet engines]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar fleet systems]] to increase performance in tight quarters, which proved useful when navigating the narrow tunnels of the second Death Star.<ref name="Customizable Card Game 2">''{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Scythe 1}}''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mianda first appeared in the third installment of the original Star Wars trilogy - [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] released in [[1983]]. In the film he is one of the several officers present during Darth Vader's arrival. He was portrayed by an uncredited extra. His scenes were filmed in [[Elstree Studios]] in [[February]] [[1982]].<ref name="Aficionado">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|name=STAR WARS AFICIONADO|url=2023/03/jedi-at-40-mister-motivator-comes-to.html|text='JEDI' AT 40: MISTER MOTIVATOR COMES TO THE DEATH STAR!|date=2023-03-22|archivedate=20260612142938}}</ref> However he was first identified and given a name and backstory in the [[2000]] [[Death Star II Limited]] expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] by [[Decipher]].<ref name="Customizable Card Game" />

In [[2010]], the toy company [[Hasbro]] released an action figure of Mianda in his pilot jumpsuit attire as part of the ''Battle over Endor'' pack of the [[Star Wars Vintage Collection]]. Mianda's action figure is in fact a repaint of a previous TIE pilot figure released in [[2009]]. Curiously, hasbro for whatever reason used [[Temuera Morrison]]'s likeness to portray Mianda.<ref name="TOY">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side|pack=(Toys R Us Exclusive) Battle Over Endor (2 of 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tvcexbattleoverendor2.asp}}</ref> Another pilot character named [[Oxixo/Legends|Oxixo]] received the same treatment.<ref name="OxiClean">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side|pack=(Toys R Us Exclusive) Battle Over Endor (1 of 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TVCEXBattleOverEndor1.asp}}</ref>
